pr_title: cli: fix import CLI test deadlock
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/65651)

issue_context.title: cli: deadlock in TestImportCLI
issue_context.body:
I was working in an unrelated PR which causes certain CLI commands to fail.
As I was attempting to debug this, my troubleshooting steps were seriously impeded by a deadlock in `TestImportCLI`.

The problem is this code in `runImportCLICommand()`:

```go
  wg.Add(1)

  go λ() {
    out, err = c.RunWithCapture(cliCmd)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    wg.Done()
  }()
```

When the command encounters an error, `require.NoError` stops the goroutine, and `wg.Done` is never called, and the test deadlocks.

This needs to be changed to only check the error after the goroutine terminates.
Additionally, the remainder of the code underneath must properly handle the case when the import command fails to update `knobs.uploadComplete`. For this a `select` should be used that combines a read on an error channel.

review_comments:
This will leak a goroutine if the code below stops (e.g. at require.NoError) before it reads.

You can avert that:
- by adding a buffer of 1 in the channel in the `make` above, OR
- by closing the channel here after writing to it and deferring a read from the channel in the function above before creating the goroutine

oh interesting, in the buffer of 1 case, I think I also need to remove the `defer close(errCh)` from the main test function too. Otherwise, the `require.NoError` would cause the test to return, closing the channel, and then the goroutine would panic on write to a closed channel.
you only `close` inside the goroutine, not the outer function. (With a defer to tolerate panics inside the goroutine)
